title: Perfect :)
body:
Simple, easy to use app with the right amount of functionality. I'm still deciding which one works better for me - this or the Balanced - almost the same app, same developer actually, but the Balanced is more of a "count activities" style than the Productive's "to do list" type. I like Balanced's icon better though.

I would give it a five star if it would support family sharing.. I think both should be simply payable apps instead of the "unlock all features via in-app purchase" mechanism.
